parts.html: The K-05 standard model is a classic L-shaped kitchen in soft beige tones with a porcelain stoneware countertop.
The beige palette makes the kitchen warm and cozy and the space visually lighter. Solid-color painted fronts emphasize the neat geometry of the cabinets and the classic character of the furniture.
Work surfaces, built-in appliances, and cabinets run along two walls, and with no island there is more room for a dining area.
The porcelain stoneware countertop creates an expressive contrast of textures with the solid beige fronts.
The classic look is complemented by modern hardware: Muller Profi Line hinges with soft-close mechanisms and concealed Muller Profi Line drawer runners.
Hinges: Muller Profi Line with soft-close mechanisms
Drawer runners: Concealed Muller Profi Line
We will make the K-05 to suit your kitchen layout, utility connections, and appliances — with delivery and installation in Bratislava and Vienna.
